api: NativeQualityCollector(contract, adapter, validator, product_root, evidence_root, suites, mapping_path, review, browser_factory, sqlite_probe, mutation, mutation_probe, e2e_mode='supervisor_browser'); await collect(snapshot_hash); await QualityVerifier(contract, collector).verify(snapshot_hash)
no_manual_observations: Collector runs actual IsolatedValidator suites, actual twelve BrowserVerifier scenarios, an owned SQLite lifecycle probe and a copied authorization mutation. Missing ports are NOT_VERIFIED, never fabricated observations

suite_schema.name: backend|frontend|e2e, unique
suite_schema.source_inventory: unique canonical relative regular files, 1..20000, no links/hardlinks
suite_schema.test_args: bounded tuple passed to isolated native runner

RID.test: exact native test identity or supervisor_browser::E2E-01[alone]

review_helper: write_quality_review_package creates reviewed-test-mapping.json plus AWAITING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW quality-review-package.json. It does not approve its own inputs or call an LLM
plan_hash: native_quality_plan_hash hashes asdict suite specs, exact mapping file SHA, mutation spec and explicit e2e_mode
required_R_checks: QUALITY:e2e:supervisor_browser when this mode is chosen

observation_ports.native_suites: list of actual native row counts/exit/report_valid/critical skip-xfail/source_files/source_fingerprint/image_id/environment_fingerprint/raw_report(path,sha256)/output(path,sha256)
observation_ports.requirement_test_mapping: RID -> reviewed assertion rows augmented from actual outcomes with executed bool and execution_status
observation_ports.coverage: backend/frontend -> exact inventory + executable line/branch counters + domain mappings + fresh raw_report(path,sha256); omitted unexecuted source cannot be dropped from denominators
observation_ports.real_sqlite_test_environment: isolated=True, isolated_root, supervisor-exported database_path, >=2 actual connection_ids, restart_verified and cleanup_owned_only measured by closing a separate owned diagnostic runtime
observation_ports.browser_e2e: 12 exact source-defined scenario rows, six alone + six together; actual X/V receipts and matching mode/source/check observations. Aggregated e2e suite preserves FAIL and NOT_VERIFIED, collected=12; no product Playwright suite is pretended
observation_ports.authorization_mutation: temporary_copy, original_before/after SHA, physical original_file/mutated_file artifacts, canonical mutation_snapshot_hash, nominal and mutant SEC-09/SEC-10/FUN-06 observed checks + scoped intact X proofs. At least one actual observed false and X passed=False is required to detect mutation; R-only failure does not count

sqlite_callback: async sqlite_probe(adapter,snapshot_hash,contract_hash); root can bind coordinator.sqlite_quality_probe(state,contract,snapshot_root,snapshot_hash,evidence_root) through a closure
mutation_callback: async mutation_probe(copy_root,snapshot_hash,contract_hash); nominal root and canonical frozen mutant are run independently on real HTTP/API/DB/browser. Source review/profile on mutant must explicitly match its canonical digest
mutant_copy: One exact reviewed authorization replacement on distinct filtered stage, original never changed. write_bytes preserves CRLF. No product config/scripts/imports execute on host
source_expectations: Frozen reference coverage thresholds and six E2E section-8 scenarios unchanged; generator fragments are source exact
limits: Prepared collector interfaces and executable meta-tests are not a full generated-product conformity campaign
External independent GPT6.1 medium source/profile reviews remain required; no Claude review call
Product Chromium needs DockerBrowserSession exact NETNONE capability; local fixture opt-in is not campaign authority
